attempts.summary: Deployed a 3-member etcd v3.5.17 cluster across node1/node2/node3 (AlmaLinux 9.6) as systemd services with static bootstrap over the private network, with firewalld ports 2379/2380 opened. Verified cross-node replication (write on node1, read on node2/node3), verified continued read/write availability with quorum (2/3) while node3 was stopped, and verified node3 caught up on the missed key after rejoining. Then completed the mandatory sequential single-node-restart protocol on all three nodes (native systemctl reboot, one at a time, quorum preserved throughout), proving changed boot_id and full data/cluster-membership/quorum recovery after each restart.
